daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

NasDem chairman Surya Paloh expressed support for any electoral system for the 2029 elections provided it is conducted sportingly, while separately warning that a government unwilling to accept correction would be dangerous. Paloh also stated that the nation must not rely on elderly people like himself and expressed optimism that NasDem will increase its vote in 2029. PDI-P Secretary-General Pramono Anung, in an apparent reference to PKB chairman Muhaimin Iskandar, remarked that those who leave their party never become big, adding that PDI-P has examples of such people.

  • President Prabowo commissioned graduates of Akmil and Akpol as military and police officers, including Tribrata, the son of Ferdy Sambo.
  • The DPR confirmed it will continue discussing draft laws during recess in order to meet public needs.
  • Attorney General Yusril Ihza Mahendra said he is confident Prabowo has mature considerations in appointing Kuntadi as Jampidsus and stated that Kuntadi knows his main task is to resolve the Febrie case.
  • President Prabowo explained his reasons for establishing Universitas Republik Indonesia (URI), which will be led by Donny Ermawan as governor and will manage three education bodies in coordination with the education ministries.
  • Home Affairs Minister hoped that IPDN graduates will become agents of change for the civil service.
  • The government revised the presidential regulation on environmental fund management.
  • Pramono Anung recounted how PKB nominated Megawati as vice president in 1999, and separately Megawati visited a historical photo exhibition with Prananda Prabowo.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The Indonesian government confirmed that the deportation of a Palestinian followed an Interpol notice. TNI forces are pursuing OPM members after three civilians were killed in Papua. Indonesia's national counter-terrorism agency BNPT called for stronger community resilience against radicalism.

  • Indonesia is partnering with OceanX to protect marine national parks, with the organization set to research seven marine national parks with the forestry ministry.
  • The Berau regency and Seychelles are exploring candlenut cultivation on post-mining lands.
  • An ASEAN-Indonesia Blue Economy delegation studied blue economy practices in Banyuwangi.

Other

President Prabowo appointed Sudaryono as the new head of the Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN) to replace Nanik S. Deyang, who resigned from her position. Sudaryono stated that BGN cannot run from MBG problems and acknowledged that the agency is not superman and is ready to accept input. BGN announced it had cut the MBG budget to Rp 229 trillion and identified that the issue with electric motorcycle procurement was mark-up. BGN and the Attorney General's Office teamed up to strengthen oversight of the free meals program.

  • Finance Minister Purbaya discussed the current state budget condition.
  • President Prabowo targeted completion of school revitalization nationwide by 2029, while the government separately targets 500 People's Schools by 2029, and over 8.8 million students joined a free health check program.
  • The Agriculture Minister claimed Indonesia has achieved self-sufficiency in eight food commodities, and the ministry purchased ITS hybrid corn seed for Rp 10 billion while boosting corn output with new high-yield seed.
  • Indonesia is preparing a survey to map white hydrogen in Sulawesi and aims to lower green hydrogen prices using excess renewable power.
  • The Supreme Court rejected the PK petition of Emirsyah Satar in the Garuda aircraft corruption case.
